description:
Goal
Make EmissionReadyProgram and BackendProgram preserve artifact-owned inventory while carrying transport-backed references/facts, not old recursive layouts, into downstream consumers. This is also the atomic deletion point for the remaining artifact-local LocalCallableId / CallableWitness / derive_runtime_transports compatibility solver.

Required change
EmissionReadyExecutable and BackendExecutable retain stable executable indexes, call edges, body inventory, value types/reprs that are true artifact facts, extern marshals, effects, and dispatch. Transport-owned movement facts are carried as plan revision plus ShapeId/TransportPosition/CallableId/BoundaryId/seam-fact references or explicit rows copied from TransportPlan for the handoff contract. BackendEntry origins and entry captures must name resume/capture transport positions or facts rather than TrashRuntimeValueLayout trees.

Deletion in the same commit
Remove runtime_params, return_layout, resume_layouts, entry_capture_layouts, TrashRuntimeParamLayout, TrashRuntimeInputLayout, TrashRuntimeValueLayout, TrashRuntimeLane, and TrashReturnAbi from live artifact/emission/backend structs once the equivalent handoff fact is plan-backed. Delete LocalCallableId, LocalCallableProducer-as-artifact-authority, CallableWitnessState, ExecutableCallableWitnesses, WitnessMemo, ExecutableCallableFacts, IncomingLocalCall, CallableWitnessPlan, CallableWitnessResolver, ValueWitnessFact, SettledCallableWitnesses, derive_runtime_transports, deliver_callsites/resume_delivery_demand as layout authority, trash_runtime_input_layout_from_demand, trash_runtime_value_layout_from_demand, trash_local_callable_layout, and witness slot/join helpers.

Downstream boundary
Do not solve native/interpreter/codegen value lowering here beyond what is necessary to compile against the new handoff. If a downstream consumer still walks TrashRealizedValue, TrashBackendValue, TrashDeliveredShape, or TrashNativeDemandAbi, leave that to fz-hwn.19.3-.19.5 with the exact new artifact fact it must read. But no artifact/emission/backend record may require the old recursive layout solver after this ticket.

Tests
Assert emission/backend handoff inventory names the same ShapeId or transport position for producer return and delivered resume, and that callable entries/native-boundary inputs have BoundaryId-backed contracts rather than type-derived layout. Existing backend/native behavior tests may remain downstream red only when the failing code is outside artifact and has a named follow-up ticket.

Checks
Targeted artifact/backend tests; cargo check --all-targets; rg confirms live artifact structs and jobs no longer expose TrashRuntime*, TrashReturnAbi, LocalCallableId, CallableWitness*, derive_runtime_transports, or trash_runtime_* layout builders.
title: Artifact seam: carry transport-backed handoff through emission and backend
